newsitem.title: USA: Albright - US censure would threaten Mexico recovery.
newsitem.headline: Albright - US censure would threaten Mexico recovery.

text.p: Moves in the U.S. Congress to censure Mexico over its anti-drug efforts would undermine financial confidence in Mexico and set back the country's economic recovery, Secretary of State Madeleine Albright said Thursday.

"Decertification would damage our broader interests .... it would shake financial confidence in Mexico and undermine the economic recovery we have done so much to promote," Albright said in a written statement.

The House of Representatives voted Thursday to overturn President Clinton's "certification" that Mexico is an ally in the fight against drugs unless he reports within 90 days that Mexico has made substantial progress in improving its performance.
Albright pledged to continue to work with Congress to explain why decertification would "undermine our fight against drugs and harm our interest in a stable and prosperous Mexico."
